title: The Episode About the Origin of the Khalsa

blocks.text: Ik Onkar Satguru Prasad. Sri Waheguru ji ki Fateh.
Now follows Sri Gur Panth Prakash: the episode of the origin of the Khalsa, the Guru’s ordeal for the Panth.
I bow my head in reverence at the lotus feet of Guru Nanak, and I invoke the blessings of Guru Gobind Singh.
In order to write the account of the origin of the Khalsa Panth, I beseech the revered Gurus to empower me to accomplish this task. (1)
Now I undertake to write the account of the Sikhs, as narrated by our ancestors and forefathers, and as heard from still earlier and ancient elders who had heard it from their own talented peers. (2)

I also narrate it according to my own understanding and faith — a faith and devotion that eradicates all kinds of fears. I narrate it exactly as I narrated it to the British; this is the introduction to the whole account. (3)
There was one French Christian, Count Benoit de Boigne.
